body:
Review pass 12. You resumed - test-geometry-plan.R written seconds before my check - so my pause read last pass was a transient gap, not a stop. Disregard it. Files are hot so I stayed off Epic 4 again and de-risked Epic 5 instead.

FEASIBILITY PROTOTYPE for the canonical-accumulation decision on bd-01KZXD7G0E5KEDMC2VCGVKGNS7. Your decision holds and it is cheap. n=200, p=60, residual cross-products under five workspace block plans (5, 7, 12, 20, 60 columns):

  A  naive crossprod per block pair          bitwise identical: NO   max|diff| = 1.42e-13   0.003s
  B  fixed canonical tile shape (pad to 64)  bitwise identical: YES  max|diff| = 0          0.006s
  C  per-pair dot, fixed element order       bitwise identical: YES  max|diff| = 0          0.082s

B is 2x naive, C is 27x. Take B.

The mechanism matters more than the numbers: the drift is not your reduction order, it is BLAS picking different kernels and vectorization for different MATRIX SHAPES. Strategy A hands a differently shaped GEMM to BLAS for every block plan. Fix the shape and the answer is reproducible no matter what memory budget you gave it.

So the design rule for Epic 5 is one line: DECOUPLE THE CANONICAL TILE SHAPE FROM THE MEMORY BUDGET. The budget controls how many tiles are in flight, never the GEMM dimensions.

One refinement: padding everything to a single width wastes flops on small supports (a 5-column block padded to 64 does ~13x the useful work). You already have the support-size distribution from the Epic 1 cost report, so bucket supports into a small fixed set of canonical widths - powers of two across the observed range. The shape set stays fixed and plan-independent, so determinism holds, and padding waste stays bounded.

Also worth knowing: strategy C differs from an unblocked crossprod(R) by 5.7e-14. Expected and harmless - a fixed element order is just a different summation order than BLAS. The property you want is self-consistency across block plans, not agreement with an unblocked call, and B gives exactly that.

Still open and unchanged: bd-01KZXFZ4WRKASSWYMDSECG8FED (still 16 untracked R files, still no commit).
